topics.name: Offline Sync Engine
topics.concept: Mobile apps must work without connectivity, queuing changes locally and merging when the network returns. The engine implements an outbox with conflict resolution strategies like last-write-wins and field merge. It makes airplane mode a non-event.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates local edits with server-side conflicts.
topics.real_world_use: Used in field-work and messaging apps.

topics.name: Push Notification Scheduler
topics.concept: Push notifications need scheduling with quiet hours, batching, and per-user preferences. The scheduler queues messages with delivery windows and priority. It respects attention.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates notification streams with user prefs.

topics.name: Deep Link Router
topics.concept: Deep links route URLs into specific app screens, handling cold starts and deferred links. The router parses link patterns dispatching to screens with parameters. Marketing links land in the right place.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates links with valid and broken routes.

topics.name: App State Persistence
topics.concept: Apps should restore exactly where the user left off, so state persistence snapshots navigation and form data. The tool saves and restores state across simulated process death. Continuity survives the OS killer.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives navigation with random kills.

topics.name: Battery Profiler
topics.concept: Background work drains batteries, so the profiler attributes energy to wakelocks, GPS, and network. It models consumption per component recommending batching. Efficient apps get used more.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes component activity.

topics.name: Memory Warning Handler
topics.concept: iOS and Android warn apps before killing them for memory, and graceful degradation beats a crash. The handler simulates pressure levels triggering cache eviction and quality reduction. It survives the squeeze.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG ramps memory pressure.

topics.name: Crash Report Grouper
topics.concept: Thousands of crashes reduce to a few stack signatures, and the grouper clusters them. It normalizes frames, hashes signatures, and ranks by affected users. Triage starts with groups.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates crashes from root bugs.
topics.real_world_use: Used by mobile teams triaging stability.

topics.name: ANR Detector
topics.concept: Application Not Responding errors happen when the main thread blocks, and the detector finds the culprits. It analyzes main-thread traces attributing stalls to disk, network, or lock contention. Jank gets a name.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates traces with blocking calls.

topics.name: Reachability Monitor
topics.concept: Apps must adapt to connectivity changes: wifi to cellular to offline. The monitor tracks network state transitions informing sync and quality decisions. The app degrades gracefully.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates commutes with tunnels.

topics.name: Request Retry Queue
topics.concept: Failed API calls deserve persistent retry with backoff, surviving app restarts. The queue stores requests durably retrying with exponential backoff. Nothing gets lost to a tunnel.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fails requests with network gaps.

topics.name: Image Cache Manager
topics.concept: Image-heavy feeds need memory and disk caches with eviction, or scrolling janks and data balloons. The manager implements two-level caching with LRU and size caps. Smooth scrolling, bounded storage.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG scrolls feeds with image loads.
topics.real_world_use: Used in social and commerce apps.

topics.name: Pagination Controller
topics.concept: Infinite lists page data with cursors, handling refresh, prepend, and error states. The controller manages page state machine with placeholders. Lists feel endless but stay correct.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG serves pages with occasional errors.

topics.name: Form Validation Engine
topics.concept: Forms need field-level validation with clear errors, from email formats to cross-field rules. The engine validates with composable rules showing messages inline. Bad input gets kind feedback.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fills forms with mistakes.
topics.real_world_use: Used in signup and checkout flows.

topics.name: Biometric Auth Flow
topics.concept: Biometric login needs fallback paths when sensors fail or users opt out. The flow simulator handles success, failure, lockout, and PIN fallback. Security stays usable.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives auth attempts with sensor failures.

topics.name: Secure Storage Vault
topics.concept: Tokens and secrets belong in the keychain or keystore, not plain files. The vault simulates encrypted storage with biometric-gated access. Secrets stay secret.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG stores and retrieves secrets.

topics.name: Certificate Pinning Checker
topics.concept: Pinning ties the app to expected server certificates, defeating rogue CAs. The checker validates pins against certificate chains with backup pins for rotation. MITM gets much harder.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG presents chains with pin matches and mismatches.

topics.name: App Version Gate
topics.concept: Old app versions break against new APIs, so gates enforce minimum versions with graceful messaging. The gate checks versions against policy with force and soft update paths. Fragmentation gets managed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG distributes version adoption.

topics.name: Feature Flag Client
topics.concept: Mobile feature flags need local evaluation with cached rules for offline use. The client fetches flag configs evaluating targeting on-device. Rollouts reach mobile safely.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns users to flag variants.

topics.name: A/B Test Assigner
topics.concept: Experiments need sticky deterministic assignment so users see consistent variants. The assigner hashes user IDs into variants with stratification. Results stay valid.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns large user bases.

topics.name: Analytics Event Batcher
topics.concept: Analytics events batch for efficiency with offline storage and upload policies. The batcher queues events flushing on size, time, or connectivity. Insights without battery drain.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits app events.

topics.name: Session Tracker
topics.concept: Sessions define engagement metrics, with timeouts and background handling varying by platform. The tracker computes session boundaries from event streams. Analytics get consistent definitions.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates app usage sessions.

topics.name: Screen Flow Mapper
topics.concept: Understanding navigation paths reveals UX friction, so the mapper builds transition graphs from screen views. It finds common paths and drop-offs. Design gets data.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG navigates apps with goals.

topics.name: Onboarding Checklist
topics.concept: Progressive onboarding completes steps like profile and permissions with skip handling. The checklist tracks completion optimizing for activation. First-run experience gets engineered.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG walks users through onboarding.

topics.name: Permission Request Flow
topics.concept: Permission prompts need timing and rationale or users deny forever. The flow simulator tests pre-prompts and fallback UX. Access gets granted.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates user grant decisions.

topics.name: Geofence Simulator
topics.concept: Geofences trigger actions on entering or leaving areas, with battery-efficient monitoring. The simulator models circular fences with dwell times and accuracy noise. Location features stay practical.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG moves users through fence areas.
topics.real_world_use: Used in retail and reminder apps.

topics.name: Background Fetch Scheduler
topics.concept: Background fetch updates content opportunistically within OS energy budgets. The scheduler models fetch intervals adapting to usage patterns. Fresh content, happy battery.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates app usage and content changes.
topics.real_world_use: Used in news and feed apps.

topics.name: Local Notification Center
topics.concept: Local notifications schedule reminders and timers without servers. The center manages scheduling, grouping, and actions. Timely nudges stay on-device.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG schedules reminders.

topics.name: In-App Purchase Validator
topics.concept: Purchase receipts need server-side validation to prevent fraud. The validator checks receipt signatures and subscription states. Revenue stays real.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates receipts with forgeries.

topics.name: Subscription Status Tracker
topics.concept: Subscriptions cycle through trial, active, grace, and expired with billing quirks. The tracker models state transitions driving entitlement. Access matches payment.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives subscription lifecycles.

topics.name: Paywall Experiment
topics.concept: Paywalls trade conversion against revenue with pricing and timing tests. The experiment framework tests variants measuring trial starts. Monetization gets scientific.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates purchase decisions.

topics.name: Review Prompt Scheduler
topics.concept: Review prompts must catch happy moments without nagging, respecting platform quotas. The scheduler triggers on positive signals with cooldowns. Ratings rise politely.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG models user satisfaction.

topics.name: App Size Analyzer
topics.concept: App size affects install conversion, so the analyzer attributes megabytes to modules and assets. It finds the heavy hitters. Smaller apps get installed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds app bundles.

topics.name: Asset Bundle Downloader
topics.concept: On-demand assets keep initial downloads small, fetching packs as needed. The downloader manages pack manifests with resumable transfers. Big games fit in small installs.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG requests asset packs.

topics.name: Delta Update Simulator
topics.concept: Delta updates ship only changed bytes, and the simulator diffs versions measuring patch sizes. It shows why small changes mean small downloads. Updates stay quick.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG versions binaries with changes.

topics.name: Theme Manager
topics.concept: Dark mode and themes need centralized color tokens with smooth switching. The manager resolves themed values per mode with persistence. Apps look right everywhere.
topics.data_idea: Theme needs derive from design tokens.

topics.name: Localization Checker
topics.concept: Translations break layouts with longer strings and missing keys, so the checker validates completeness and length. It flags untranslated strings and overflow risks. Global apps stay polished.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG translates with gaps.

topics.name: RTL Layout Tester
topics.concept: Right-to-left languages mirror layouts, and the tester verifies mirroring correctness. It checks alignment and icon flipping. Arabic and Hebrew users get proper UI.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG mirrors layouts with bugs.

topics.name: Accessibility Auditor
topics.concept: Accessibility labels, contrast, and touch targets make apps usable for everyone. The auditor scans screens against guidelines. Inclusion gets measured.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds screens with a11y gaps.

topics.name: Haptic Pattern Composer
topics.concept: Haptics communicate through vibration patterns, from subtle ticks to alerts. The composer designs patterns with intensity curves. Touch gets a voice.
topics.data_idea: Patterns derive from UX intents.

topics.name: Widget Data Provider
topics.concept: Home screen widgets show glanceable data with timeline updates. The provider builds timelines with refresh policies. Info stays fresh on the home screen.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG updates widget data.
topics.real_world_use: Used in iOS and Android widgets.

topics.name: Shortcut Manager
topics.concept: App shortcuts and Siri intents surface actions outside the app. The manager registers shortcuts with donation analytics. Power users move faster.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG donates shortcut usage.

topics.name: Share Extension Handler
topics.concept: Share extensions receive content from other apps with type validation. The handler processes shared items with size limits. Apps join the share sheet.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG shares content items.

topics.name: Chat Message Sync
topics.concept: Chat needs ordered, deduplicated message sync with read receipts. The sync engine merges histories across devices. Conversations stay consistent.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG exchanges messages with conflicts.

topics.name: Media Upload Manager
topics.concept: Photo and video uploads need chunking, retry, and background completion. The manager uploads with progress and compression choices. Sharing survives bad networks.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG uploads media over flaky networks.

topics.name: QR Code Ticket Wallet
topics.concept: Tickets as QR codes need offline rendering with anti-screenshot considerations. The wallet generates signed payloads with refresh. Entry stays smooth.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG issues tickets.
